name: hedera-merchant-payments
description: Non-custodial merchant payment gateway on Hedera: on-chain invoices, HTS/HBAR checkout, SaucerSwap any-token quote+settlement, Mirror reconciliation, HCS receipts you can reconstruct without the database, signed webhooks, HIP-1215 scheduled expiry.

envVars.description: Gateway operator account (ECDSA) — pays for HCS receipt topics and refund scheduling; never holds customer funds
ECDSA private key for the operator account above
Merchant settlement account — customer payments land here directly (non-custodial)
HTS token the merchant wants to receive (e.g. testnet USDC); leave empty to accept HBAR only
SaucerSwap V1 router Hedera id or EVM address (testnet 0.0.19264). Required for any-token checkout; leave empty to disable swaps
SaucerSwap V1 factory (testnet default 0.0.9959). Used by the live quote endpoint
WHBAR token used as the one-hop quote token (testnet default 0.0.15058). The swap never wraps HBAR itself
HCS topic collecting settlement receipts (created by `reconciler:once --init-topic`)
Postgres connection string for the invoice ledger
HMAC-SHA256 secret used to sign outbound webhooks

instructions: The gateway is NON-CUSTODIAL: customers pay the merchant, or swap via a live SaucerSwap V1 quote then an atomic swap. Receipts reconstruct from the HCS topic with no database. This software never holds customer funds.
Run `hardhat:deploy --network hederaTestnet` before starting the dashboard, then paste INVOICE_REGISTRY_ADDRESS into .env.

steps.text: Merchant payment gateway — pay HBAR, the invoice HTS token, or any other HTS token via a live SaucerSwap V1 quote then an atomic swap. Reconstruct receipts from HCS with no database. The gateway never keeps the money.
